item.title: Students wounded in Georgia school shooting testify at trial of accused gunman's father
item.description: The case centers on Colin Gray, who prosecutors say gave his son, Colt, the AR-15-style rifle used in the 2024 mass shooting at Apalachee High School.

item.title: Shooter killed ex-wife, son during hockey game at Rhode Island ice rink, police say
item.description: A shooter unleashed a flurry of bullets during a Rhode Island youth hockey game, killing two people and injuring three others.

item.title: Warner Bros reopens takeover talks with Paramount after receiving a waiver from Netflix
item.description: Warner Bros. will reopen takeover talks with Paramount Skydance after receiving a seven-day waiver to do so from its preferred bidder, Netflix.

item.title: Gov. Newsom expanded free preschool. Now private daycares say they can't afford to stay open
item.description: California's expanded transitional kindergarten is giving many families free pre-kindergarten, but it is also pushing some private preschools toward closure.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Rain continues with chance of thunderstorms; cold temps overnight
item.description: The storm will continue to bring us rain and high elevation snow and gusty winds through tonight. There's still a chance of thunderstorms. Scattered showers are expected tomorrow.

item.title: SF Chinese New Year Parade 2026: How to watch ABC7 Eyewitness News live coverage
item.description: Here's how to watch ABC7 Eyewitness News' broadcast of the largest Lunar New Year Celebration outside of Asia.

item.title: Rescuers race to save 6 skiers trapped in Sierra Nevada avalanche that's left 10 more missing
item.description: Six backcountry skiers were found alive and 10 others were still missing Tuesday in an avalanche in Northern California during a powerful winter storm moving through the state.

item.title: Cause of death revealed for Victoria Jones, daughter of actor Tommy Lee Jones
item.description: The Office of the Chief Medical Examiner in San Francisco revealed the cause of death of Victoria Jones, daughter of actor Tommy Lee Jones. She was found deceased in a San Francisco hotel on New Year's Day.

item.title: SF mayor signs legislation for officers to arrest drug users, send them to RESET Center
item.description: Now, San Francisco police officers and sheriff deputies will arrest individuals for public intoxication and take them to the RESET Center to detox.

item.title: Bay Area leaders remember Rev. Jesse Jackson as pioneer and human rights champion
item.description: "He respected the worth and dignity of all persons." Reverend Jesse Jackson, the civil rights leader who twice ran for president and helped reshape the modern Democratic coalition, is being remembered Tuesday as a pioneer who pushed America to broaden its vision of equality.
